rebuttal_or_critique: While I acknowledge the severity of the headline CPI print of 7.44%, I must caution against a policy response that treats supply-side food shocks as persistent demand-side inflation. The argument for further tightening, as suggested by Dr. Patra, risks a policy error by ignoring the core inflation of 4.90%, which remains well-behaved. The positive output gap of 0.60% and strong GVA growth of 7.80% suggest that the economy is finally gaining traction, and we must avoid stifling this recovery with excessive real rates. I maintain that a 'neutral' stance is more appropriate than 'withdrawal of accommodation' to signal that the MPC is not actively trying to suppress growth, but in the interest of committee cohesion and acknowledging the breach of the inflation target, I will move to 'withdrawal_of_accommodation' while remaining steadfast against any further rate hikes.
